summary: Fixed the yy_Archive directory permission issue that was causing the 'warning: could not open directory yy_Archive/: Operation not permitted' message during git status. The directory and all its subdirectories had owner-only permissions (drwx------). Applied chmod -R 755 recursively to make them readable. The warning is now gone. Git can now see the archive files, so suggested adding yy_Archive/ to .gitignore to keep git status clean.
